verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has a public pricing page (coreweave.com/pricing) that describes on-demand and Spot GPU instances you can use without long-term commitments, so pricing is at least publicly presented without a sales gate. The captured text is only marketing copy, though, and shows no actual per-GPU-hour rates or GPU-type list. Missing for 10: evidence of explicit per-GPU-hour prices, coverage of every GPU type, confirmation that no sales contact is needed, independent corroboration.
